findings.should_be: Drop the clause 'and is the only two step telling', or replace it with 'and is preferred over the equivalent two step recitations in claim 19 at line 745 and claim 23 at line 759 because it is the description's own account'. Claims 19 and 23 each recite steps i) and ii), and the artifact emits two-step pathways for both.

findings.problem: The flag claims no assay purity is stated anywhere in the patent, but the patent states the tembotrione content of the product of both inventive crystallizations and recites a content in the claims.
findings.quote: [0039] By means of the crystallization according to the invention, the form A is obtained with a tembotrione content of as a rule at least 90 wt. %, often 94 wt. %, in particular at least 96 wt. %. checks_passed.check: recall - pathway count against the transformations the document discloses
checks_passed.what_was_verified: I counted the routes in the source myself before looking at the record count and got 56 section-level terminal transformations: the generic form A process (lines 163 to 220), the generic form C process (lines 289 to 323), the form B process (line 356), claim 19 (lines 745 to 748) and claim 23 (lines 759 to 762) at two steps each; 15 worked examples, being Example 1 (line 374), the 8 rows of Table 1 (lines 382 to 389), the 4 rows of Table 2 (lines 410 to 413), Example 14 (line 426) and Example 15 (lines 432 to 437); 23 comparative experiments, being Comparative Example 1 (line 443), Comparative Example 2 (line 447), the 8 rows of Table 3 (lines 457 to 464), the 10 rows of Table 4 (lines 483 to 492) and the 3 rows of Table 5 (lines 513 to 515); 3 stability conversions (lines 527, 529, 531); and 10 formulation examples I to X (lines 645 to 688). The artifact has exactly 56 section-scope records and they map one to one onto the 56 terminal steps in reactions.json with no gap and no extra. No transformation is counted twice and none is collapsed. The heading 'Comparative Examples 21 to 22' against three printed rows 21, 22 and 23 is caught by the artifact's own flag section_heading_says_21_to_22_but_table_5_at_lines_511_to_515_prints_three_rows_21_22_and_23.

There is no pathways-provenance.json, and that is the expected shape rather than a defect: runs/CN104292137A/output/stages/A3-pathways/ and runs/CN111440099B/output/stages/A3-pathways/ each contain pathways.json and nothing else. Both were read only; nothing was written under either. The top-level key set of all three files is identical, 22 keys, so no field is missing from or extra in this artifact relative to the reference runs.

checks_passed.check: precision - key starting material is never a solvent and is always among the cited step's reactants
checks_passed.what_was_verified: For all 58 records I checked that ksm.identifier appears in the earliest step's reactant_names and is not any compound with role solvent on that step. All 58 pass. No solvent, wash, drying agent, seed crystal or excipient is nominated as a starting material anywhere. All 58 ksm entries also resolve to a compound_uuid in the finalised pathways.json, so the identity the downstream stage binds from the string exists in compounds.json in every case.

checks_passed.check: fidelity - chain construction, intermediates, product and aggregates
checks_passed.what_was_verified: Checked mechanically on all 58 records against reactions.json. intermediates equals the ordered products of every step except the last, on all 58 including the seven two-step chains where the intermediate is 'tembotrione'. product equals the terminal step's product_name on all 58. overall_yield_pct is null on all 58 and is correctly null, because no step in the document carries a yield. overall_purity_pct is null on all 58 and equals the terminal step's product_purity_pct in every case, so no aggregate was computed from a value the patent does not state. Every enrichment field and pathway score is null as rule 13 requires, and no id or uuid field is present that should have been omitted.

Boiling and reflux are never recorded as a temperature: 'boiling methanol' at line 374, 'boiling n-pentanol' at line 443 and 'the boiling point of the solvent' at lines 378, 453 and 479 all leave temperature.type not_specified and appear only as prose in heating_method. Ranges are not flattened to points: 20 to 160 C at line 183, 80 to 150 C at line 309, at most 100 C at line 165, at least 80 C at line 297 and 10 to 30 C at line 525 are all carried as min_c and max_c. Time conversions are all correct: 'about 40 mins' to 0.67 h, '16 hrs' to 16.0, and 2, 8 and 3 days at lines 527, 529 and 531 to 48.0, 192.0 and 72.0. Example 15's 6.0 to 110.0 C span matches lines 432 and 437. 'over night' is left null for time on both Example 15 and Comparative Examples 11-20, consistently. scale is micro for the 150 mg and about 50 mg charges and lab for the 7.6 g charge at line 432, matching rule 21's boundaries.

No step in this document states a product mass or a yield, so no step-level yield arithmetic can be formed and none was fabricated. I summed all ten formulation recipes independently: I 20+3+17+60, II 5+95, III 20+2+8+2+68, IV 20+10+70, V 10+17+2+1+7+63, VI 20+10+70, VII 50+50, VIII 75+25 and X 0.5+99.5 all reach 100, and only IX at line 684 reaches 101 against a stated 20 wt. % content. mass_balance_implausible is raised on that step alone and on no other, and the pathway inherits it. The one loading anomaly in the examples, 150 mg of tembotrione in 0.15 ml of methanol at line 374, is about 1000 g/l against the 100 to 800 g/l the patent gives at line 169, and it is flagged as printed_charge_of_150_mg_against_0_15_ml_of_methanol_is_a_loading_the_solvent_cannot_support_recorded_as_printed rather than repaired.

There are five precursor links in the artifact. Four substantiate: Claims 16-33_Claim 19 Step ii and Claim 23 Step ii on Claim 19 Step i and Claim 23 Step i, and Process for Form A_Step 2 and Process for Form C_Step 2 on their Step 1, in each case the precursor's product 'tembotrione' being the sole reactant of the linked step. No precursor_step points at a step that does not exist, so unresolved_precursor correctly does not appear. The fifth is the Preparation of Form B case reported above.

All 1804 tag occurrences across pathway and step tags match the pattern category:value with lowercase snake_case ASCII values, with no casing errors and no malformed entries. Every value in a closed category is inside its list: solvent_class, catalyst_class, workup_type, purification, step_role, linkage and is_one_pot all check out against the A2 rule 26 lists. reaction_class uses only formulation, other and recrystallisation, all three in the rule 17 list; mechanism_type is not_determinable throughout, in the rule 20 list; scale uses micro, lab and not_specified, all in the rule 21 list; reaction_class_confidence is high throughout. The derived categories are right: chain_length 1 or 2 matching the step count on every record, branching:linear and convergence:linear correct because no step has more than one precursor or feeds more than one step, and lcl:short correct for every 1 and 2 step chain.

I verified each distinct flag against the source rather than accepting it. Confirmed true: no_synthetic_transformation_in_patent and no_bond_is_formed_or_broken_in_any_step_of_this_patent, since every step is dissolution, crystallisation or blending and tembotrione is unchanged throughout; ksm_not_prepared_in_this_patent_wo_00_21924_cited_at_line_80_and_line_220, both citations checked and both correct; truncated_chain; ksm_taken_as_literal_first_reactant_of_step_0_asserted_present_in_reactant_names_and_components, verified on all 58; two_patent_scope_pathways_emitted_because_the_patent_states_form_a_at_line_92_and_form_c_at_line_222_as_separate_objects_of_equal_standing, both lines checked and both are object-of-the-invention statements; section_sentence_at_line_356_names_modification_a_as_the_reference_process_and_2_2_dimethylpropanol_as_the_solvent_replaced_which_are_incompatible, genuinely incompatible because 2,2-dimethylpropanol is form C's solvent at line 291 and is absent from form A's solvent list at line 163; section_heading_says_21_to_22_but_table_5_prints_three_rows; product_identifier_has_no_a1_compound_record_so_compound_uuid_cannot_resolve, which appears on exactly the 32 records whose product.compound_uuid is null in the finalised file, a count I reproduced independently; form_b_appears_as_a_formulation_input_although_the_patent_excludes_it_from_the_invention, matching the form A or form B at line 680 which is the one formulation example of ten that names form B; comparative_example_not_according_to_the_invention on exactly 23 records; product_is_a_mixture_of_two_modifications_not_a_pure_form on exactly the 21 mixture products; single_step_chain_not_a_multistep_route on exactly the 51 one-step records; recited_inputs_are_alternatives_not_a_single_ksm on exactly the 14 multi-reactant records. I also checked all ten a2_provenance_quote_cites_line_NNN_which_is_an_en_translation_line flags, which look wrong against the per-section A2 provenance files but are correct against the merged reactions-provenance.json that A3 takes as input: in all ten cases the cited line (648, 652, 656, 660, 664, 668, 677, 681, 685, 689) is an '> EN:' line that reactions-provenance.json really does cite, and the line named as the printed source (647, 651, 655, 659, 663, 667, 671, 680, 684, 688) really is the printed line. That was my strongest suspected finding and it does not hold.

Every step validation_flag in reactions.json is reflected in its pathway's honest_uncertainty_flags: no_conditions to no_conditions_in_chain on 5 records, cross_reference_unresolved to cross_reference_unresolved_in_chain on 3, conditions_unresolved to conditions_unresolved_in_chain on 1, a1_missing_compound to a1_missing_compound_in_chain on 1, and mass_balance_implausible on 1. No pathway is presented clean when assembled from flagged steps. All 47 rule-11 fields are present on every step, with the single role divergence reported above.

I opened p04.png myself at high magnification and read the three structures in paragraph [0002] off the page. All three IMAGE_EXTRACT spans at lines 74, 76 and 78 are correct in ring system, in every substituent and in every substituent position. Formula I is drawn with an sp3 C2 flanked by two ring ketones and the SMILES gives C2C(=O)CCCC2=O; I' is drawn with a ring ketone, a ring C2=C3 double bond and an OH on C3 and the SMILES gives C2=C(O)CCCC2=O; I'' is drawn with two ring ketones and an exocyclic C(OH)= to the aryl and the SMILES gives C(O)=C2C(=O)CCCC2=O. On all three aryl rings I traced the positions round from the acyl attachment and read Cl ortho, CH2-O-CH2-CF3 meta and SO2CH3 para off the page, which is the 2-chloro, 3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl), 4-methylsulfonyl pattern all three SMILES encode and the title at line 68 names. No position was inferred from the name. The stated formula C17H16ClF3O6S checks by hand atom count for all three tautomers. There are no reaction schemes anywhere in the document, so no above-arrow and below-arrow reagent merge is possible and no background scheme could have been annotated as the invention's route; the only other drawings are the three XRPD plots on p02 and p03, from which the enriched text explicitly refuses to read any 2-theta value. The pathways artifact carries no structural field at all, so this check bears on it only indirectly.

checks_passed.check: the form presented differently from the others
checks_passed.what_was_verified: The document claims forms A and C as its two objects (lines 88, 92, 222) and disclaims form B, which is described but excluded: 'the form B also described here, not according to the invention' at lines 181 and 307, 'Unlike the modifications A and C, modification B cannot be stably formulated' at line 325, and the heading '(not According to Invention)' at line 439. The artifact does reflect this asymmetry: form B is never a product of a section labelled as the invention's, its preparation section is named as not according to the invention, 31 records carry a form B disclaimer flag, 23 carry comparative_example_not_according_to_the_invention, and the single formulation example that admits form B is separately flagged. The only defect is the wrong line citations inside that disclaimer flag, reported above.

The artifact emits two patent-scope pathways where rule 8 says one, and records this rather than hiding it, in prompt_rule_8_expects_a_single_patent_scope_pathway_and_this_is_a_recorded_deviation_not_an_oversight. I judged this a defensible recorded deviation and not a finding: lines 92 and 222 do present form A and form C as objects of equal standing, so there is no single overall target to choose between them. For contrast, runs/EP2045236A1 emits one patent-scope pathway. Rule 8's instruction to emit both the section and the patent record even when the steps coincide is followed: the two patent-scope records reuse the Process for Form A and Process for Form C step ids, which is what production does and is not a double count.
